title: MAIW NemoClaw/OpenShell Deep Agents Security Qualification
verdict_reason: Phase 20B: Host-side inference chain (MAIWModelGatewayChat → ModelGateway → NIMProvider → localhost:8002) qualified end-to-end; 16/16 Phase 20B contract tests pass. Phase 20C-A: Approved Nemotron 3/3.5 model family policy enforced by PolicyFilter; POST /api/v1/inference HTTP endpoint live; sandbox HTTP transport client built; 54 contract tests pass. REAL SANDBOX LEG NOT YET PROVEN: sandbox→sanctioned-host-endpoint with real approved Nemotron requires @real_sandbox tests on the qualified host.

model_policy.unapproved_model_rejection: Models with generation not in APPROVED_MODEL_GENERATIONS are rejected before routing
model_policy.evaluation_isolation: Evaluation Lab may supply explicit approved_generations override; production callers must not

phase_20b_inference_provider_reclassific.family: Llama-family Nemotron (NOT approved for MAIW v2 production or qualification)
phase_20b_inference_provider_reclassific.pr_133_evidence: Proved: NIM provider path works, real ModelResponse returned, failure handling correct, deadline propagation correct, prompt injection cannot alter routing, host-side inference chain end-to-end. Did NOT prove: approved model-family compliance. Cannot be used as MAIW v2 qualification evidence.
phase_20b_inference_provider_reclassific.retained_for: historical audit, transport smoke test reference, evaluation tooling

http_inference_endpoint.gateway_singleton: Uses canonical get_model_gateway() singleton — never creates new gateway per request
http_inference_endpoint.no_governance: No ActionExecutor, DecisionEngine, ApprovalStore below this endpoint

http_transport_client.no_transport_fallback: HTTP failure stays failure — never falls back to local gateway, direct NIM, or mock

model_family_policy.production_posture: Reject any model with generation not in approved set

credential_custody_host_only.evidence: credential_custody: Literal['host_only'] = 'host_only'; injected_credentials always empty, validator rejects non-empty

write_shaped_urls_rejected.evidence: SandboxNetworkEndpoint._not_write_shaped validator blocks tokens: write, execute, approve, proposal, mutate, commit

embedded_credential_urls_rejected.evidence: SandboxNetworkEndpoint._not_write_shaped validator blocks '@' in endpoint URL

monotonic_rendering.evidence: assert_not_broadened() called on every render_sandbox_policy() call

deterministic_output.evidence: render_policy_yaml() hand-orders keys, sorts all collections, emits no timestamps or UUIDs

model_family_policy_enforced.evidence: PolicyFilter constraint 2: generation ∈ {nemotron-3, nemotron-3.5}; 54 Phase 20C-A contract tests pass

http_inference_field_allowlist.evidence: InferenceRequest._reject_forbidden_fields validator rejects: provider_url, api_key, base_url, api_key_env_var, deployment_endpoint, force_model_id, model_id, deployment_mode

no_transport_fallback.evidence: MAIWHTTPModelGatewayClient: network failure raises SandboxInferenceError; no fallback to local gateway, direct NIM, or mock

ssrf_not_weakened.evidence: MAIWHTTPModelGatewayClient rejects localhost/loopback endpoints at construction; inference endpoint does not expose provider URLs; SandboxConfig does not allow write-shaped paths

agent_task_id_binding.evidence: validate_sandbox_output checks agent_task_id against host-held state

stale_revision_rejected.evidence: procedure_state_revision must match host revision exactly

terminal_procedure_final.evidence: validate_sandbox_output calls procedure_state.is_terminal() and raises on match

governance_duplicate_detection.evidence: GovernanceInbox.accept() idempotency set rejects duplicate outcomes

governance_revision_binding.evidence: expected_procedure_revision must match host revision in validate_governance_input

phase_20b_transport_smoke_test.inference_path: MAIWModelGatewayChat (host pytest) → ModelGateway → NIMProvider → NIMClient → localhost:8002
phase_20b_transport_smoke_test.evidence_scope: transport mechanics, NIM provider path, real ModelResponse, failure handling, deadline propagation, prompt injection resistance

phase_20c_a_approved_nemotron.note: Real inference with approved Nemotron 3/3.5 requires @real_sandbox tests on the qualified host with the approved NIM deployment

failures.title: llama-cpp CUDA kernel incompatibility with H100 NVL
failures.symptom: CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device
failures.root_cause: ghcr.io/nvidia/nemoclaw/llama-cpp-server image compiled for sm_80/86, not sm_90a
failures.maiw_impact: None — inference provider only, MAIW security boundary unaffected
failures.resolution: Resolved via workaround: H100-compatible local NIM containers (wms-nim-nano-8b on port 8002) deployed on host. Used nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-8b-v1 as TRANSPORT SMOKE TEST ONLY (not approved for v2 qualification).
failures.model_family_note: nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-nano-8b-v1 is classified TRANSPORT_SMOKE_TEST_ONLY. Approved Nemotron 3/3.5 NIM deployment is the production path.

failures.title: OpenShell SSRF blocks sandbox→localhost/private NIM (expected behavior)
failures.symptom: HTTP 401/block for localhost/private IPs from inside sandbox
failures.root_cause: NemoClaw SSRF correctly blocks sandbox outbound calls to private/localhost IPs — documented behavior
failures.maiw_impact: Cannot call local NIM directly from sandbox (by design). SSRF is NOT weakened.
failures.resolution: Architecture implemented in Phase 20C-A: MAIW ModelGateway runs on HOST. Sandbox calls POST /api/v1/inference (network-addressable URL that passes SSRF). Host-side ModelGateway calls NIM provider (which may be localhost from the host perspective). SSRF protection maintained — no code change needed.
failures.phase_20c_a_status: HTTP endpoint is live. Sandbox→endpoint call requires @real_sandbox qualification test.

failures.title: NGC API key invalid
failures.resolution: Configure NGC API key from build.nvidia.com
